candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified official fact or deterministic rounded-snapshot metric, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.monthly_snapshot: The July 2026 BDUK values are rounded management-information figures limited to initial contract scope, with variable ingestion lag; they do not establish exact-address completion, current availability, orderability or contractual milestone compliance.
scope_guards.derived_snapshot: Ranks, shares and gaps are deterministic calculations over the displayed rounded July table and displayed totals. They are not official statistics, parcel backlogs, forecasts or exact-address delivery claims.
scope_guards.supplier_aggregate: Supplier totals and shares are arithmetic groupings of displayed contract rows. They do not establish supplier-wide commercial coverage, contract performance or address-level service availability.
scope_guards.complaint_scope: Ofcom complaint figures are regulator-received aggregate rates and relative comparisons; they do not represent every customer complaint, exact-address service quality or the merit of an individual case.
scope_guards.adr_scope: ADR KPIs describe scheme-level process performance; they do not predict or determine the outcome, eligibility or timing of an individual dispute.
scope_guards.switching_scope: Switching guidance describes standard processes and deadlines; actual charges, eligibility, number retention and service continuity depend on the provider and case facts.
scope_guards.contract_scope: Contract guidance summarises consumer protections and information requirements; applicability depends on customer type, service and contract terms and is not legal advice.

expansion_rule: For each July 2026 BDUK contract emit fifteen records: supplier, contracted, built, contracted-minus-built gap, built share, share of displayed contracted total, share of displayed built total, contracted rank, built rank, gap rank, built-share rank, supplier contract count, supplier contracted total, supplier built total and supplier built share. Append 45 Ofcom complaint, ADR, mobile switching, broadband switching and contract-checklist records. Equal numeric values share competition rank. Every fifth expanded record is REVALIDATION; all others are UPGRADE.
